messages:
raj: FYI rolling redwood-cu12-2026 to eu-west-2 just triggered a provisioning/ container-rebuild loop on a subset of GPU nodes. nodes keep going to PROVISION_FAILED then back to rebuild. anyone else seeing RTLD/PTX noise?
michelle: looking at first logs from one node — modprobe failing + loader errors. snippet: ```modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-rtld-x86_64\n/usr/local/bin/entrypoint: error while loading shared libraries: libnvidia-ptx.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory```
sam: this looks like a mismatch between the container runtime's gcc/toolchain and the host driver ABI. we compiled the runtime bits with gcc 13 in the new image; host driver on some hosts is 525.x which expects older libstdc++ symbols. seeing undefined symbol: GLIBCXX_3.4.29 and CXXABI versions.
raj: repro on 3 zones (eu-west-2a/b/c) but only on nodes that were patched with kernel 5.15.45 last week. other nodes with 5.15.20 are fine. maybe kernel module signatures/rtld path changed?
olga: also getting repeated ptx JIT cache complaints in the kubelet logs: "ptx_jit: failed to compile ptx: JIT compiler error: module->getJitInfo returned NULL" — might be causing rapid container restart and PTX cache churn.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy redwood-cu12-2026 -> eu-west-2 (20 nodes) started at 2234567800. Monitoring: health checks failing on 6 nodes.
ben: cost note — since the failure started we've been cycling nodes, autoscaler spinning up replacements. estimate ~6 hours of churn so far, ~+$8k in spot churn and image rebuild work. need a rollback ASAP.
michelle: attaching a fuller error snippet: ```/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2: symbol lookup error: /opt/runtime/lib/libnvidia-ptx.so: undefined symbol: _ZSt24__throw_out_of_range_fmtPKcz@GLIBCXX_3.4.30```
sam: quick triage: 1) gcc13 -> libstdc++ ABI bump 2) kernel module alias/rtld path differences 3) JIT PTX cache format changed; older driver can't parse new cache. probable root: our image build baked a newer nvptx-toolchain/ptx-lib that produces cache incompatible with 525/old kernels.
raj: proposed immediate actions: a) pause canary (stop further rollouts) b) pin new node provisioning to redwood-cu11-stable for eu-west until we fix images c) rollback cu12 tag on the provisioner pool and drain affected nodes for manual inspection. anyone disagree?
olga: +1 to pause. also suggest we hotfix the image to build with gcc12 toolchain and regenerate PTX cache artifacts then re-run a small canary.
ben: agreed on rollback. ops: please open emergency billing ticket and notify sales of potential customer impact in eu-west.
infra-ci: ci/build-redwood-cu12-2026: FAILURE — ptx-compatibility-tests failed on x86_64-kernel-5.15.45 matrix. https://ci.internal/builds/3321
sam: long-term: add a minimal preflight matrix: combinations of (driver version, kernel minor, gcc toolchain) that we smoke before rolling to provisioner. also add a runtime check that fails containers fast with a clear error to avoid rebuild loops.
raj: action items captured: PAUSE_CANARY, ROLLBACK_TO_CU11_TAG, HOTFIX_IMAGE_WITH_GCC12_OR_PIN_DRIVER, ADD_CI_MATRIX. I'll DM infra-sre to get rollback scheduled. thanks all :thumbsup:
